_meta.description: Service dependency map with tier assignments (T0–T4) and dependency criticality (hard/soft). Tier placement governs build order; criticality defines blast radius on failure. Includes 30 existing services (SVC-001–SVC-017, SVC-050–SVC-055, SVC-100–SVC-106) plus 7 new observability/zero-trust infrastructure services (SVC-107–SVC-113).

tier_definitions.label: T0 FOUNDATION
tier_definitions.description: No upstream service dependencies. Must exist before anything else can be provisioned. Includes identity, networking, event fabric, secret storage, observability ingestion, and audit. Build first; every other tier depends on at least one T0 service.

tier_definitions.label: T1 CORE INFRASTRUCTURE
tier_definitions.description: Depends only on T0 services. Contains compliance-prerequisite services (KYC/AML, Fraud Detection, Sanctions Screening) that regulators require to be operational before any customer-facing money-movement capability is enabled, plus the telemetry stores that back the observability pipeline.

tier_definitions.label: T2 BUSINESS SERVICES
tier_definitions.description: Depends on T0 + T1. Core money-movement, account management, risk, and data services. These are the atomic business capabilities that composite services in T3 compose from.

tier_definitions.label: T3 COMPOSITE SERVICES
tier_definitions.description: Depends on T0 + T1 + T2. Multi-dependency business capabilities that orchestrate across multiple T2 services, plus channel and operational services. Zero-trust policy enforcement sits here because it needs the full observability stack.

tier_definitions.label: T4 OVERLAY
tier_definitions.description: Depends on the full stack (T0–T3). Build last. These services compose across composite services and require customer onboarding and account management to already exist.

services.name: Identity & Access Management
services.build_notes: T0 — no upstream dependencies. IAM is the root trust anchor for the entire platform. Every service authenticates and authorises through IAM at startup and per-request. Must be operational and data-seeded before any other service boots.
enables: Authentication and authorisation for all 36 services
API Gateway (SVC-101) token validation
Event Bus (SVC-102) producer/consumer identity
Service-to-service mTLS identity via Service Mesh (SVC-106)
Zero-Trust Policy Engine (SVC-113) trust evaluation

services.name: API Gateway
services.build_notes: T0 — treated as dependency-free at tier level. Although API Gateway consumes IAM tokens at runtime, it is co-provisioned at T0 as an infrastructure primitive; its IAM dependency is a runtime routing concern, not a boot-order blocker. All external-facing services route inbound traffic through the gateway.
enables: North-south traffic ingress for all 23 client-facing services
Rate limiting, TLS termination, and request routing
OAuth2 token introspection at the edge

services.name: Event Bus
services.build_notes: T0 — Kafka-backed event fabric. No upstream service dependencies. All async domain events, audit events, and notification triggers are routed through the Event Bus. Must be provisioned with topics and ACLs before compliance services (T1) can subscribe.
enables: Async domain event propagation across all business services
KYC/AML (SVC-010) and Fraud Detection (SVC-009) event subscriptions
Notification Service (SVC-053) trigger pipeline
Data Platform (SVC-104) event ingestion

services.name: Audit & Logging Service
services.build_notes: T0 — no upstream service dependencies. Produces structured audit events consumed by the OTel Collector (SVC-107). In the new observability model, SVC-103 acts as a structured-audit emitter and forwards to SVC-107; it is not a store itself — stores are SVC-108 to SVC-111. All 29 other services write audit trails through SVC-103 at runtime.
enables: Structured audit trail for all 29 downstream services
Regulatory audit log feed into OTel Collector (SVC-107)
WORM-compliant audit forwarding to SVC-111

services.name: Secrets Management
services.build_notes: T0 — no upstream dependencies. Vault-backed secrets store. All services retrieve DB credentials, API keys, and TLS certificates from SVC-105 at startup. Must be seeded with initial secrets before any dependent service can boot.
enables: Credential injection for Event Bus (SVC-102) and Service Mesh (SVC-106)
Database credential rotation for Data Platform (SVC-104)
PKI certificate issuance for mTLS across the mesh

services.name: Service Mesh
services.build_notes: T0 — no upstream dependencies. Provides mTLS east-west traffic encryption, circuit breaking, and service discovery. Although it consumes certificates from SVC-105, it is provisioned as infrastructure alongside SVC-105 at T0. No downstream service lists Service Mesh as an explicit boot dependency, but all services operate within the mesh at runtime.
enables: mTLS encryption for all east-west service-to-service calls
Circuit breaking and retries for all downstream services
Service discovery and load balancing across the cluster

services.name: OTel Collector
services.build_notes: T0 — must exist before any service emits telemetry. The OpenTelemetry Collector is the single ingestion point for all traces, metrics, logs, and audit events. It fans out to the four stores (SVC-108–SVC-111). If the collector is absent, services cannot ship observability data and compliance obligations for real-time monitoring cannot be met.
enables: Log ingestion pipeline to Log Store (SVC-108)
Distributed trace pipeline to Trace Store (SVC-109)
Metrics pipeline to Metrics Store (SVC-110)
Compliance audit stream to WORM Audit Log Store (SVC-111)
Full observability stack required by Zero-Trust Policy Engine (SVC-113)

services.name: Log Store
services.build_notes: T1 — depends only on OTel Collector (T0). Receives structured logs from SVC-107 and persists them for query. Must be available before the Observability Aggregator (SVC-112) can provide unified log views.
enables: Persistent structured log storage for all services
Log query input to Observability Aggregator (SVC-112)

services.name: Trace Store
services.build_notes: T1 — depends only on OTel Collector (T0). Receives distributed trace spans from SVC-107. Required by the Observability Aggregator (SVC-112) for correlated trace/log views.
enables: Distributed trace persistence for end-to-end request correlation
Trace input to Observability Aggregator (SVC-112)

services.name: Metrics Store
services.build_notes: T1 — depends only on OTel Collector (T0). Receives time-series metrics from SVC-107. Required by the Observability Aggregator (SVC-112) for SLO dashboards and alerting.
enables: Time-series metrics persistence for SLO monitoring and alerting
Metrics input to Observability Aggregator (SVC-112)

services.name: Audit Log Store / WORM
services.build_notes: T1 — depends only on OTel Collector (T0). Write-once read-many (WORM) store for regulatory audit trails. Operates on a separate compliance pipeline from the other stores to ensure tamper-evident storage. Regulators (PRA/FCA) require immutable audit storage to be operational before any customer-facing transaction is processed.
enables: Immutable regulatory audit log for FCA/PRA compliance
Tamper-evident record for all financial transactions
Audit input to Observability Aggregator (SVC-112)

services.name: KYC/AML Service
services.build_notes: T1 — compliance prerequisite. KYC/AML must be operational before any account can be opened or payment processed. Regulatory requirement (MLR 2017, JMLSG guidance) mandates KYC checks prior to onboarding. Depends on IAM (hard) for identity context and Event Bus (hard) for async customer-data events.
enables: Customer due diligence checks required by Customer Onboarding (SVC-050)
AML screening required by Commercial Accounts (SVC-013)
Compliance reporting inputs for Compliance Service (SVC-016)

services.name: Sanctions Screening Service
services.build_notes: T1 — compliance prerequisite. OFAC, UN, and HMT sanctions lists must be screened on every payment and onboarding event. Sanctions Screening must be live before Domestic Payments (SVC-014), International Payments (SVC-007), and Card Processing (SVC-008) can process any transaction. Hard dependency on IAM and Event Bus.
enables: Real-time sanctions screening for Domestic Payments (SVC-014)
Cross-border sanctions checks for International Payments (SVC-007)
Card authorisation screening for Card Processing (SVC-008)
Onboarding screening for Customer Onboarding (SVC-050)

services.name: Fraud Detection Service
services.build_notes: T1 — compliance prerequisite. Fraud Detection must be live before any payment or card transaction can be authorised. PSD2 and FCA PS19/26 require real-time fraud screening. Hard dependency on IAM for entity context and Event Bus for streaming transaction events to the ML pipeline.
enables: Real-time fraud scoring for Domestic Payments (SVC-014)
Card authorisation fraud checks for Card Processing (SVC-008)
Merchant acquiring fraud screening for Merchant Acquiring (SVC-006)
Credit card fraud detection for Credit Card Service (SVC-002)

services.name: Retail Accounts Service
services.build_notes: T2 — core account management. Depends on IAM (hard) and Event Bus (hard). Retail accounts are the foundational financial instrument for the retail banking domain. Mortgage (SVC-001), Credit Card (SVC-002), Wealth Platform (SVC-017), and Open Banking API (SVC-011) all require a retail account to exist before they can operate.
enables: Current and savings account management for retail customers
Account context required by Mortgage Service (SVC-001)
Account context required by Credit Card Service (SVC-002)
Account data for Open Banking API (SVC-011)
Portfolio base for Wealth Platform (SVC-017)

services.name: Commercial Accounts Service
services.build_notes: T2 — core commercial account management. Depends on IAM (hard) and Event Bus (hard). Commercial accounts underpin Trade Finance (SVC-004), Treasury (SVC-005), and Domestic Payments (SVC-014) for corporate customers. Note: in the full catalogue SVC-013 also has soft dependencies on SVC-050 and SVC-010 at runtime, but those are captured as soft edges here because SVC-013 can boot without them.
enables: Corporate current and lending account management
Account context required by Trade Finance (SVC-004)
Account base for Treasury Service (SVC-005)
Corporate payment account for Domestic Payments (SVC-014)

services.name: Domestic Payments Service
services.build_notes: T2 — core payment rail. Hard dependencies on IAM, Event Bus, Sanctions Screening, and Fraud Detection enforce the regulatory requirement that no payment clears without sanctions and fraud checks. Mortgage (SVC-001) and Treasury (SVC-005) depend on this for settlement. International Payments (SVC-007) uses it as the domestic leg of cross-border transactions.
enables: Faster Payments and BACS payment execution
Domestic settlement leg for International Payments (SVC-007)
Payment execution for Mortgage disbursement (SVC-001)
Treasury settlement execution (SVC-005)
Open Banking payment initiation (SVC-011)

services.name: Risk Engine Service
services.build_notes: T2 — core risk assessment. Depends on IAM and Event Bus. Risk Engine is required by Credit Decision (SVC-052) and Wealth Platform (SVC-017) for exposure scoring. Treasury (SVC-005) uses it for market risk limits. The Data Platform (SVC-104) feeds model inputs; that is a soft runtime dependency.
enables: Risk scoring input for Credit Decision Service (SVC-052)
Market risk limits for Treasury Service (SVC-005)
Portfolio risk assessment for Wealth Platform (SVC-017)

services.name: Credit Decision Service
services.build_notes: T2 — depends on Risk Engine (T2) and IAM (T0). Credit Decision is the automated underwriting gateway consumed by Mortgage (SVC-001), Trade Finance (SVC-004), and Wealth Platform (SVC-017). Hard dependency on Risk Engine because a credit decision cannot be issued without a risk score.
enables: Automated mortgage underwriting for Mortgage Service (SVC-001)
Trade credit limits for Trade Finance (SVC-004)
Wealth credit facility assessment for Wealth Platform (SVC-017)
Credit eligibility check during Customer Onboarding (SVC-050)

services.name: Data Platform
services.build_notes: T2 — depends on Event Bus (T0). Data Platform ingests all domain events from Kafka and exposes analytics and ML model inputs. Although the service catalogue lists IAM and Secrets Management as runtime dependencies, the tier assignment treats Event Bus as the hard structural dependency for boot order; IAM/Secrets are ambient infrastructure available from T0.
enables: ML model inputs for Fraud Detection (SVC-009) and Risk Engine (SVC-015)
Analytics and reporting for Compliance Service (SVC-016)
Wealth analytics for Wealth Platform (SVC-017)
Risk model training data for Credit Decision (SVC-052)

services.name: Observability Aggregator
services.build_notes: T2 — depends on all four observability stores (SVC-108–SVC-111, all T1). Provides unified correlated views across logs, traces, metrics, and audit. Required by the Zero-Trust Policy Engine (SVC-113) for runtime policy decisions based on observed service behaviour.
enables: Correlated log/trace/metric dashboards for platform operations
SLO burn-rate alerting fed from Metrics Store
Compliance audit query interface over the WORM store
Behavioural context feed for Zero-Trust Policy Engine (SVC-113)

services.name: Mortgage Service
services.build_notes: T3 — composite retail lending product. Requires Retail Accounts (hard) to link the mortgage to a customer account, Credit Decision (hard) for automated underwriting, and Domestic Payments (hard) for disbursement and repayment collection. Customer Onboarding (soft) and Document Management (soft) enrich the process but degraded mode is possible.
enables: Residential mortgage origination and servicing for retail customers

services.name: Credit Card Service
services.build_notes: T3 — composite retail credit product. Hard dependency on Retail Accounts for account linkage and Fraud Detection for real-time authorisation screening. Credit Decision is soft (pre-issuance only); Customer Onboarding is soft (enrichment).
enables: Credit card issuance, authorisation, and statement management for retail customers

services.name: Trade Finance Service
services.build_notes: T3 — composite commercial banking product. Requires Commercial Accounts, Sanctions Screening, Domestic Payments, and KYC/AML as hard dependencies (all regulatory obligations for trade instruments). International Payments and Document Management are soft (degraded mode available).
enables: Letters of credit, trade guarantees, and documentary collections for corporate clients

services.name: Treasury Service
services.build_notes: T3 — composite treasury management. Hard dependencies on Domestic Payments for settlement execution and Sanctions Screening for counterparty screening. Commercial Accounts, Risk Engine, and Data Platform are soft (analytics and market risk feeds — degraded mode available).
enables: FX, money market, and liquidity management for corporate treasury desks

services.name: Merchant Acquiring Service
services.build_notes: T3 — composite acquiring product. Hard dependency on Card Processing (SVC-008) for authorisation network connectivity and KYC/AML (SVC-010) for merchant due diligence. Customer Onboarding and Sanctions Screening are soft enrichment paths.
enables: Merchant payment acceptance, settlement, and chargeback management

services.name: International Payments Service
services.build_notes: T3 — composite cross-border payment service. Hard dependency on Sanctions Screening (OFAC/HMT mandatory for all cross-border payments) and Event Bus for SWIFT/SEPA message routing. Domestic Payments is soft (used as the domestic settlement leg when available).
enables: SWIFT and SEPA cross-border payment execution
FX conversion and correspondent banking for Trade Finance (SVC-004)
Cross-border settlement for Treasury (SVC-005)

services.name: Card Processing Service
services.build_notes: T3 — composite card network service. Hard dependency on Fraud Detection (hard — PCI DSS requirement for real-time authorisation fraud check) and Sanctions Screening (hard — OFAC screening on card-present transactions). IAM is hard for HSM-backed key access. Event Bus is soft (async settlement notifications).
enables: Visa/Mastercard authorisation network connectivity
Real-time card authorisation for Credit Card Service (SVC-002)
Acquiring authorisation for Merchant Acquiring (SVC-006)

services.name: Open Banking API Service
services.build_notes: T3 — PSD2/Open Banking channel. Hard dependencies on IAM (OAuth2/FAPI consent flow), Domestic Payments (payment initiation), and Retail Accounts (account information). Fraud Detection and KYC are soft enrichment paths required to meet EBA RTS SCA obligations in production but not needed for bootstrap.
enables: PSD2-compliant Account Information Service (AIS) and Payment Initiation Service (PIS)
Third-party provider API access under Open Banking UK standards

services.name: Compliance Service
services.build_notes: T3 — composite compliance orchestration. Hard dependency on KYC/AML for customer due diligence records and Data Platform for regulatory analytics. Sanctions Screening, Document Management, and Workflow Engine are soft (available at T3 but Compliance can operate in reduced mode without them).
enables: Regulatory reporting (FCA, PRA, BoE) aggregation
SAR (Suspicious Activity Report) generation pipeline
CDD/EDD case management

services.name: Wealth Platform Service
services.build_notes: T3 — composite wealth management platform. Hard dependencies on Retail Accounts (portfolio linkage) and Credit Decision (credit facility assessment). Risk Engine, Customer Onboarding, and Data Platform are soft enrichment paths.
enables: Investment portfolio management and advisory services for HNW retail customers

services.name: Customer Onboarding Service
services.build_notes: T3 — composite onboarding orchestrator. Hard dependency on KYC/AML (MLR 2017 requires identity verification before account activation) and IAM. Sanctions Screening, Notifications, Document Management, and Workflow Engine are soft — onboarding can reach a 'pending documents' state without them.
enables: End-to-end digital customer onboarding (identity, KYC, account creation)
Onboarding prerequisite for Insurance Distribution (SVC-003)
Onboarding prerequisite for Mortgage Service (SVC-001 soft)

services.name: Notification Service
services.build_notes: T3 — placed here because its consumers (SVC-003, SVC-012, SVC-013) are T2/T3 and benefit from notifications being available early in T3. Hard dependency only on Event Bus for inbound trigger events. All other IAM/API Gateway dependencies are ambient T0 infrastructure.
enables: SMS, email, and push notification delivery for all domain services
Transaction alert pipeline for Retail Accounts (SVC-012) and Commercial Accounts (SVC-013)

services.name: Document Management Service
services.build_notes: T3 — cross-cutting document store. Hard dependency on IAM for access control. Positioned at T3 rather than T2 because its primary consumers are T3 services. Document Management can degrade gracefully — services fall back to deferred document capture.
enables: Secure document storage and retrieval for 11 downstream services
Regulatory document retention for KYC (SVC-010) and Compliance (SVC-016)

services.name: Workflow Engine
services.build_notes: T3 — cross-cutting process orchestrator. Hard dependencies on Event Bus (workflow state transitions via Kafka) and IAM (task assignment and audit). Consumed by KYC/AML, Compliance, and Customer Onboarding for long-running regulatory workflows.
enables: Long-running KYC case management workflows (SVC-010)
Compliance case escalation workflows (SVC-016)
Multi-step onboarding orchestration (SVC-050)

services.name: Zero-Trust Policy Engine
services.build_notes: T3 — depends on IAM (T0), OTel Collector (T0), and Observability Aggregator (T2). Zero-Trust policy evaluation requires the full observability stack to make contextual policy decisions based on real-time service behaviour. Placed at T3 because it needs the T2 Observability Aggregator's correlated view.
enables: Runtime zero-trust policy enforcement for all east-west service calls
Behavioural anomaly detection fed by observability telemetry
Dynamic policy updates based on threat intelligence from IAM and the observability stack

services.name: Insurance Distribution Service
services.build_notes: T4 — overlay product. Hard dependencies on Retail Accounts (T2) for the underlying account and Customer Onboarding (T3) because insurance products require a fully onboarded and KYC-verified customer. Document Management and Notification Service are soft. Build last as it adds a revenue overlay on top of the full account and onboarding stack.
enables: Insurance product distribution (life, home, travel) to verified retail customers
Bancassurance revenue overlay on retail banking relationships

build_order.rationale: All T0 FOUNDATION services have no upstream service dependencies and can be provisioned in parallel. IAM, API Gateway, Event Bus, Audit & Logging, Secrets Management, Service Mesh, and OTel Collector form the immutable substrate that every other service requires at boot time. Regulatory obligation: no customer data may be processed before audit and identity infrastructure is operational (FCA SYSC 8, PRA SS2/21). Infrastructure provisioning order within this phase: Secrets Management first (certificates needed by others), then IAM and OTel Collector in parallel, then remaining T0 services.

All T1 CORE INFRASTRUCTURE services can be built in parallel once T0 is complete. KYC/AML (SVC-010), Sanctions Screening (SVC-051), and Fraud Detection (SVC-009) are compliance prerequisites mandated by MLR 2017, OFAC, HMT, and PSD2 respectively — they must be live and data-seeded before any customer-facing money-movement service is deployed. The four observability stores (SVC-108–SVC-111) must be available before T2 services start emitting production telemetry. The WORM Audit Log Store (SVC-111) must be operational before any financial transaction is processed per FCA record-keeping rules (COBS 9A, SYSC 9).

Phase 3 builds the core T2 business services that form the atomic capabilities for retail and commercial banking. Retail Accounts, Commercial Accounts, Domestic Payments, Risk Engine, and Data Platform can be built in parallel as they share only T0/T1 upstream dependencies. Domestic Payments (SVC-014) is the critical path item: it requires Sanctions Screening (SVC-051) and Fraud Detection (SVC-009) from Phase 2, confirming the regulatory gate has been passed. Data Platform must be available to feed ML model inputs to Risk Engine and Fraud Detection.

Phase 4 completes the T2 tier with services that depend on Phase 3 outputs. Credit Decision Service (SVC-052) requires Risk Engine (SVC-015) from Phase 3. Observability Aggregator (SVC-112) requires all four stores from Phase 2. These two services unblock the bulk of T3 composite services: Credit Decision is a hard dependency for Mortgage, Trade Finance, and Wealth Platform; Observability Aggregator is a hard dependency for Zero-Trust Policy Engine. Separating Phase 4 from Phase 3 avoids a circular wait on Risk Engine.

Phase 5 builds T3 infrastructure and channel services that are themselves dependencies for the higher-level T3 domain products. Card Processing (SVC-008) must precede Credit Card and Merchant Acquiring. International Payments (SVC-007) must precede Trade Finance and Treasury. Notification Service, Document Management, and Workflow Engine are cross-cutting T3 services consumed by onboarding and compliance flows. Zero-Trust Policy Engine (SVC-113) activates runtime policy enforcement across the growing service estate. All Phase 5 services are parallelisable.

Phase 6 builds the remaining T3 composite domain services and the Customer Onboarding orchestrator. All depend on Phase 5 outputs (Card Processing, International Payments, Document Management, Workflow Engine). Customer Onboarding (SVC-050) must be completed before Insurance Distribution (Phase 7) can be built. Compliance Service (SVC-016) activates regulatory reporting pipelines. Open Banking API (SVC-011) satisfies PSD2 Article 36 access-to-account obligations. All Phase 6 services are parallelisable within the phase.

Phase 7 builds the Mortgage Service, which depends on Retail Accounts (Phase 3), Credit Decision (Phase 4), Domestic Payments (Phase 3), Customer Onboarding (Phase 6), and Document Management (Phase 5). Mortgage is the last T3 service to be buildable because it depends on Customer Onboarding, which is only available after Phase 6. Placed in its own phase to make the dependency on Phase 6 explicit and avoid false parallelism with Phase 6 services.

Phase 8 builds the single T4 OVERLAY service, Insurance Distribution (SVC-003). It requires Retail Accounts (Phase 3), Customer Onboarding (Phase 6), Document Management (Phase 5), and Notification Service (Phase 5) to all be operational. Insurance Distribution is built last because it composes across the full account and onboarding stack — it adds bancassurance product capability as a revenue overlay and has no other service depending on it.
